headline: Georgia voters to decide fate of $17 billion data center megaproject
summary: Voters in Coweta County, Georgia, will decide in a January 12 special election whether to repeal the rezoning for Project Sail, a $17 billion data center campus.
why: Large-scale data center investments represent significant capital deployment for the technology sector and local economies, making zoning and community approval critical hurdles for developers.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Local ballot measures on multi-billion dollar infrastructure projects impact regional economic development and technology investments.
